lines.en: I walk into Uta's room to find her just lounging around and listening to music on her phone.
lines.zh: 我走进 Uta 的房间，发现她正懒洋洋地躺着，用手机听音乐。

lines.en: She hops off the bed and excitedly hurries over to me, almost slipping on a pair of pants near her end table.
lines.zh: 她从床上蹦下来，兴奋地朝我快步走来，差点被床头柜旁边的一条裤子绊倒。

lines.en: Fortunately for her, I'm able to catch her before she winds up cracking her head open on the floor.
lines.zh: 对她来说幸运的是，我在她把脑袋磕在地板上之前把她接住了。

lines.en: {i}Unfortunately{/i} for me, this gives her the opportunity to tease me for the next half hour about keeping my hands to myself.
lines.zh: 对我{i}不幸{/i}的是，这给了她在接下来的半个小时里拿“管好你的手”这件事取笑我的机会。

lines.en: I'm sure she's just kidding, but I still get the urge to let her fall next time.
lines.zh: 我敢说她只是在开玩笑，可我还是忍不住在想，下次干脆让她摔下去算了。

lines.en: Of course, I'd feel overwhelmingly guilty if she actually got hurt.
lines.zh: 当然，如果她真的受伤了，我会内疚得要死。

lines.en: And I definitely wouldn't want it to impact her appearance in any way, so...
lines.zh: 而且我绝对不希望那对她的容貌有任何影响，所以……

lines.en: I guess I can take one for the team and let her tease me for a while longer.
lines.zh: 我想我就认了吧，再让她取笑我一阵子。

lines.en: Even if I saved her life.
The night goes on with just as much quirky flirting as I expected when I came here, and I wouldn't trade a second of it for anything else.
lines.zh: 这一晚就在和我来之前预想的一样多的古怪调情中过去了，而其中任何一秒我都不会拿去换别的东西。

lines.en: Well, actually, I'd definitely trade it for the opportunity to have all of that flirting to come to fruition, but...
lines.zh: 嗯，说实话，如果能换来让那些调情真正开花结果的机会，我绝对会换，不过……

lines.en: I guess something like that just isn't in the cards for tonight.
lines.zh: 我想那种事今晚不在牌面里。

lines.en: Either way, I'm glad I got to spend some time with Uta.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我很高兴能和 Uta 待上一段时间。

lines.en: I can feel the two of us growing closer every single day.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到我们俩每一天都在变得更亲近。
